headings.text: How do you check a decision made in code?
Give each activity its place.
A command needs a physical check.
Two paths. Two different claims.
Code, connected to an observable check.

samples.visibleText: ADA MENSAH FIRMWARE / MOSSLINK 1 / Code → check How do you check a decision made in code? Ada Mensah works with embedded firmware: code that controls a physical device. For Mosslink, an environmental sensor, she wrote the firmware, scheduled power states and built the bring-up fixture. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation. Follow the connection from a code decision to something observable on the bench. Fictional prototype · The apparatus is an explanatory model, not an actual Mosslink device. 2 / Schedule Give each activity its place. Sleep → Measure → Transmit → repeat. This teaching loop explains scheduling: organizing different activities over a repeated cycle. Separating the activities makes it easier to ask which behavior to inspect at each step. Ada scheduled power states. This simplified sequence illustrates the idea; it is not recovered Mosslink firmware, its actual state topology or measured timing. No durations or current values are supplied. The console shows a teaching sequence only.

headings.text: A command needs a physical check.

samples.visibleText: 3 / Bring-up A command needs a physical check. Firmware sends a command; the board responds. The bring-up fixture provides access so that behavior on the physical board can be checked through a bench observation. The fixture supports inspection; it does not replace the board’s circuitry. Ada wrote the firmware, scheduled power states and built the fixture. A colleague designed the PCB (printed circuit board) and the analogue front end, the circuitry handling analogue signals. The separated rig illustrates those relationships. It is not a circuit, wiring plan or recovered implementation. 4 / Evidence

headings.text: Two paths. Two different claims.

samples.visibleText: 4 / Evidence Two paths. Two different claims. Measured sleep and transmit current, together with an assumed reporting interval, support a two-year projection. A separate continuous bench run supports 72 hours observed. The 72-hour run does not validate two years of endurance. Neither path establishes field conditions or customer deployment. State tables, timing diagrams, current traces and bench checklists are working documents; no original measurement table, trace, spreadsheet or run notebook is supplied here. 2 years · projected Measured current + assumed interval 72 hours · observed Separate continuous bench run The instruments label a projection and an observation. Their displays are explanatory labels, not original evidence. 5 / What this supports Code, connected to an observable check. Ada’s firmware and power-state scheduling define device behavior; her fixture work connects that behavior to a physical bench check. That is the contribution this story supports, with the projection and observed run kept distinct. Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were tested on the bench; none went to customers. One

targets.html:
5 / What this supports

Code, connected to an observable check.

Ada’s firmware and power-state scheduling define device behavior; her fixture work connects that behavior to a physical bench check. That is the contribution this story supports, with the projection and observed run kept distinct.

Forty engineering samples were assembled; six were tested on the bench; none went to customers. One preliminary emissions check passed. Full qualification is unfinished.

This is bounded bench evidence, not whole-product ownership, certification, field testing or a customer launch.
